result.instructions: Tools for ReferralHero, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the top 20 on the leaderboard of my launch campaign."; "Which referral rewards are still pending and need to be sent?"; "Who referred jane@example.com and how many of her referrals are confirmed?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ReferralHero data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run referralhero_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run referralhero_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run referralhero_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. referralhero_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: referralhero_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List the active ReferralHero campaigns (lists) in the account: uuid, name, subscriber count and creation time. The uuid is needed by every other tool. 10 per page. GET /lists.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: referralhero_get_leaderboard
tools.title: Get campaign leaderboard
tools.description: The leaderboard of a campaign: its top subscribers (10 to 100) with referral counts, points and position. GET /lists/{uuid}/leaderboard.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

tools.name: referralhero_list_campaign_rewards
tools.title: List campaign rewards
tools.description: The rewards configured for a campaign (title, description, referrals needed to win each). This is the reward setup, not who earned what: see referralhero_list_unlocked_rewards for that. GET /lists/{uuid}/bonuses.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

tools.name: referralhero_create_campaign
tools.title: Create campaign
tools.description: WRITE: create a new ReferralHero campaign (list) with a name and a default referral URL. It adds a campaign and changes nothing existing. POST /lists.

tools.name: referralhero_list_subscribers
tools.title: List subscribers
tools.description: List the subscribers of a campaign, 50 per page, with referral code, referral link, points, position, people referred, status and referrer. Sort and filter by the extra fields. GET /lists/{uuid}/subscribers.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

extra_field.description: Only subscribers whose extra field has this value.

extra_field_2.description: Only subscribers whose extra field 2 has this value.

option_field.description: Only subscribers whose option field has this value.

stripe_customer_id.description: Only the subscriber linked to this Stripe customer id.

tools.name: referralhero_get_subscriber
tools.title: Get subscriber
tools.description: One subscriber by id: contact data, referral code and link, points, position, referrals by level, status, fraud risk level, tags. Only verified subscribers are found. GET /lists/{uuid}/subscribers/{id}.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

subscriber_id.description: Subscriber id, e.g. sub_2bad325a25d7 (the id field of a subscriber).

tools.name: referralhero_get_subscriber_by_email
tools.title: Find subscriber by email
tools.description: Find one subscriber of a campaign by email. Only verified subscribers are found. GET /lists/{uuid}/subscribers/retrieve_by_email.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

tools.name: referralhero_get_subscriber_by_referral_code
tools.title: Find subscriber by referral code
tools.description: Find the subscriber who owns a referral code (the mwr value in a referral link). Only verified subscribers are found. GET /lists/{uuid}/subscribers/retrieve_by_mwr.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

referral_code.description: The referrer's referral code (the mwr parameter of a referral link).

tools.name: referralhero_search_subscribers_by_name
tools.title: Search subscribers by name
tools.description: Search subscribers by name across all campaigns of the account, 50 per page. GET /subscribers/search_by_name.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: referralhero_list_referrals
tools.title: List a subscriber's referrals
tools.description: The people a subscriber referred, 50 per page. scope: all (pending, unconfirmed and confirmed, default), level_1_confirmed, level_2_confirmed, level_3_confirmed (confirmed only, by referral level), level_2_all or level_3_all (every status at that level). GET /lists/{uuid}/subscribers/{id}/{referred|level_N_referrals|level_N_all_referrals}.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

subscriber_id.description: Subscriber id, e.g. sub_2bad325a25d7 (the id field of a subscriber).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: referralhero_list_unlocked_rewards
tools.title: List earned rewards (campaign-wide)
tools.description: Rewards unlocked by subscribers across a whole campaign: reward name, status (sent, resent, canceled, pending, flagged), value, subscriber email and id, coupon code, transaction. Filter by status to find rewards still to pay out. GET /lists/{uuid}/rewards.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: referralhero_list_subscriber_rewards
tools.title: List a subscriber's rewards
tools.description: Rewards one subscriber has unlocked, with status, value and coupon code. The reward id is what referralhero_update_reward_status needs. GET /lists/{uuid}/subscribers/{id}/rewards.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

subscriber_id.description: Subscriber id, e.g. sub_2bad325a25d7 (the id field of a subscriber).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: referralhero_list_coupon_groups
tools.title: List coupon groups
tools.description: Coupon groups of a campaign (id, name, active flag, coupons with availability), 50 per page. GET /lists/{uuid}/coupon_groups.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: referralhero_get_coupon_group
tools.title: Get coupon group
tools.description: One coupon group with all its coupons (code, available, sent_at). GET /lists/{uuid}/coupon_groups/{id}.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

tools.name: referralhero_add_subscriber
tools.title: Add subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: add a subscriber (or a referred person) to a campaign. Give the campaign's unique identifier (email, phone, wallet or custom id). By default ReferralHero sends the subscriber a confirmation (double opt-in) email and any welcome automation of the campaign: set double_optin=false to suppress the confirmation email. Set referrer (a referral code or the referrer's email) to credit a referral. POST /lists/{uuid}/subscribers.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

email.description: Subscriber email (when email is the campaign's unique identifier).

phone_number.description: Subscriber phone number (when phone is the unique identifier).

crypto_wallet_address.description: Wallet address (when it is the unique identifier).

other_identifier_value.description: Custom identifier value (when a custom id is the unique identifier).

referrer.description: Referral code or email of the referrer to credit.

double_optin.description: false = do not send the confirmation email. Default: the campaign's setting (usually sends it).

confirm.description: Must be true: the user has approved this change. It can unlock rewards and make ReferralHero email or text the subscriber or referrer (automations).

status.description: custom_event_pending = set the referral status to pending (multi-step goals).

transaction_id.description: Unique id of the purchase this referral came from.

conversion_category.description: Subscriber type for reports and segments.

device.description: Device used to sign up, for analytics.

domain.description: URL used for the subscriber's referral link.

self_reported_source.description: Where the subscriber says they heard about the campaign.

tools.name: referralhero_update_subscriber
tools.title: Update subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of a subscriber (overwrites the given fields): name, contact identifiers, extra fields, points (contest campaigns), tags, address, referral status (qualified/unqualified). Only fields you pass change. Only verified subscribers can be updated. POST /lists/{uuid}/subscribers/{id}.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

subscriber_id.description: Subscriber id, e.g. sub_2bad325a25d7 (the id field of a subscriber).

email.description: Subscriber email (when email is the campaign's unique identifier).

phone_number.description: Subscriber phone number (when phone is the unique identifier).

crypto_wallet_address.description: Wallet address (when it is the unique identifier).

other_identifier_value.description: Custom identifier value (when a custom id is the unique identifier).

referral_status.description: Mark the referral qualified or unqualified.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user has approved this change. It can unlock rewards and make ReferralHero email or text the subscriber or referrer (automations).

tools.name: referralhero_delete_subscriber
tools.title: Delete subscriber
tools.description: WRITE, DESTRUCTIVE: permanently delete a subscriber from a campaign, with their referral standing. This cannot be undone. DELETE /lists/{uuid}/subscribers/{id}.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

subscriber_id.description: Subscriber id, e.g. sub_2bad325a25d7 (the id field of a subscriber).

confirm.description: Must be true: the user has approved permanently deleting this subscriber.

tools.name: referralhero_add_points
tools.title: Add points to a subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: add points to an existing subscriber (not idempotent: each call adds again). May unlock point-based rewards. The subscriber is identified by the campaign's unique identifier. POST /lists/{uuid}/subscribers/add_points.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

email.description: Subscriber email (when email is the campaign's unique identifier).

phone_number.description: Subscriber phone number (when phone is the unique identifier).

crypto_wallet_address.description: Wallet address (when it is the unique identifier).

other_identifier_value.description: Custom identifier value (when a custom id is the unique identifier).

confirm.description: Must be true: the user has approved this change. It can unlock rewards and make ReferralHero email or text the subscriber or referrer (automations).

tools.name: referralhero_track_transaction
tools.title: Track a transaction
tools.description: WRITE: record a purchase/transaction for a subscriber (amount required) so revenue-based rewards and reports count it (not idempotent unless a transaction_id is reused). The subscriber is identified by the campaign's unique identifier. POST /lists/{uuid}/subscribers/add_transactions.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

email.description: Subscriber email (when email is the campaign's unique identifier).

phone_number.description: Subscriber phone number (when phone is the unique identifier).

crypto_wallet_address.description: Wallet address (when it is the unique identifier).

other_identifier_value.description: Custom identifier value (when a custom id is the unique identifier).

reward_value.description: A reward value to attach to the transaction.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user has approved this change. It can unlock rewards and make ReferralHero email or text the subscriber or referrer (automations).

tools.name: referralhero_confirm_referral
tools.title: Confirm a referral
tools.description: WRITE: confirm a verified referral when its third conversion event happens (campaigns whose goal tracks three events; otherwise ReferralHero returns an error). Confirming can unlock the referrer's rewards and send reward emails. Identify the referral by subscriber_id, or by the campaign's unique identifier. POST /lists/{uuid}/subscribers/{id}/confirm or /subscribers/confirm.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

subscriber_id.description: Subscriber id, e.g. sub_2bad325a25d7 (the id field of a subscriber).

email.description: Subscriber email (when email is the campaign's unique identifier).

phone_number.description: Subscriber phone number (when phone is the unique identifier).

crypto_wallet_address.description: Wallet address (when it is the unique identifier).

other_identifier_value.description: Custom identifier value (when a custom id is the unique identifier).

confirm.description: Must be true: the user has approved this change. It can unlock rewards and make ReferralHero email or text the subscriber or referrer (automations).

tools.name: referralhero_track_conversion_event
tools.title: Track a referral conversion event
tools.description: WRITE: report a conversion event for a referral (campaigns whose goal tracks two or three events). Updates the referral from pending to confirmed (two events) or unconfirmed (three). If the referral is unknown but a referrer is given, the referral is created. May unlock rewards. POST /lists/{uuid}/subscribers/track_referral_conversion_event.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

email.description: Subscriber email (when email is the campaign's unique identifier).

phone_number.description: Subscriber phone number (when phone is the unique identifier).

crypto_wallet_address.description: Wallet address (when it is the unique identifier).

other_identifier_value.description: Custom identifier value (when a custom id is the unique identifier).

referrer.description: Unique identifier of the referrer (needed to create a missing referral).

confirm.description: Must be true: the user has approved this change. It can unlock rewards and make ReferralHero email or text the subscriber or referrer (automations).

tools.name: referralhero_qualify_referral
tools.title: Mark referral qualified

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

subscriber_id.description: Subscriber id, e.g. sub_2bad325a25d7 (the id field of a subscriber).

confirm.description: Must be true: the user has approved this change. It can unlock rewards and make ReferralHero email or text the subscriber or referrer (automations).

tools.name: referralhero_unqualify_referral
tools.title: Mark referral unqualified
tools.description: WRITE: mark a referral as unqualified (for example fraud or a refund), so it no longer counts toward the referrer's rewards. POST /lists/{uuid}/subscribers/{id}/unqualify.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

subscriber_id.description: Subscriber id, e.g. sub_2bad325a25d7 (the id field of a subscriber).

tools.name: referralhero_promote_subscriber
tools.title: Promote subscriber (winner)
tools.description: WRITE: promote a subscriber to the campaign's winners list (contests and giveaways). Only verified subscribers can be promoted; an already promoted subscriber returns an error. POST /lists/{uuid}/subscribers/{id}/promote.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

subscriber_id.description: Subscriber id, e.g. sub_2bad325a25d7 (the id field of a subscriber).

confirm.description: Must be true: the user has approved this change. It can unlock rewards and make ReferralHero email or text the subscriber or referrer (automations).

tools.name: referralhero_unlock_promoted_reward
tools.title: Trigger a manual reward
tools.description: WRITE: unlock a promoted-winner or one-off reward for a subscriber. This delivers the reward and may email the subscriber and use coupon codes. POST /lists/{uuid}/subscribers/{id}/unlock_promoted_reward.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

tools.name: referralhero_update_reward_status
tools.title: Update reward status
tools.description: WRITE: set the status of an unlocked reward to sent, resent or canceled. Marking sent/resent can trigger the reward delivery email to the subscriber. Get the reward_id from referralhero_list_subscriber_rewards or referralhero_list_unlocked_rewards. POST /lists/{uuid}/subscribers/update_reward_status.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

confirm.description: Must be true: the user has approved this reward status change (sent/resent can email the reward; canceled withdraws it).

tools.name: referralhero_create_coupon_group
tools.title: Create coupon group
tools.description: WRITE: create a coupon group for a campaign, optionally with its first coupon codes. It only adds a group. POST /lists/{uuid}/coupon_groups.

uuid.description: Campaign (list) uuid, the 12-character id starting with MF (see referralhero_list_campaigns).

coupons.description: Coupon codes to put in the group.

active.description: Whether the group is active (default true).

tools.name: referralhero_add_coupons
tools.title: Add coupons to a group
tools.description: WRITE: add coupon codes to an existing coupon group. It only adds codes. POST /lists/{uuid}/coupons.
